title: Zephyr C: rejoin timeout 10x superframe constant absent (spec 09 14.8)
description: Spec 09 14.8 R-09-150: rejoin timeout is 10 x superframe length (REJOIN_TIMEOUT = 10 * superframe_len, used by DRIFTING-state transitions). Classification: implemented in Python only (python/src/lichen/timing/sfn.py:15 TDMA_REJOIN_TIMEOUT_SUPERFRAMES=10); NOT FOUND in C (lichen/subsys/lichen/link/link.h defines LICHEN_TDMA_BEACON_TIMEOUT_SUPERFRAMES=3 and LICHEN_TDMA_MISSED_BEACON_THRESHOLD=3 but no rejoin timeout) and no Rust production constant found. Suggested placement: add LICHEN_TDMA_REJOIN_TIMEOUT_SUPERFRAMES 10U to lichen/subsys/lichen/link/include/lichen/link.h, consume in tdma.c DRIFTING/REJOINING transitions, pin with BUILD_ASSERT test like lichen/tests/csma_constants/main.c; vectors tdma_ccp_fsm.json.
